1inch Aqua.revenue: The 1inch DAO's encoded share of each fill's swap fee: 1/4 of the LP fee on low-fee tiers (below ~0.1225%) and 1/6 on higher tiers, transferred to the purpose-deployed per-chain DAO fee exchanger at fill time. Positions created before the DAO fee launch (2026-07-19; enabled 2026-07-21 on BNB Chain and Robinhood Chain) carry no DAO fee and contribute only to SupplySideRevenue. Cross-checked against measured ERC20 inflows to the fee exchangers.
1inch Aqua.fees: Total Aqua swap fees paid by takers: each fill's taker-paid amount (Pushed event on the AquaRouter registry, fee-inclusive; strategy-registration pushes excluded) multiplied by the position's fee rate decoded from its on-chain strategy bytecode (SwapVM flat-fee instruction, 1e9 units = 100%). When a maker's own strategies trade against each other within one transaction, the LP fee is paid back to the same wallet and only counts on the maker's net change; the DAO share is always counted. Fills of positions on the legacy developer-release registry (pre-2026-07-19, a handful of test positions on an earlier instruction set) are excluded.

7.exchange.revenue: All integrator fees charged by 7.exchange are retained by 7.exchange, so revenue equals fees.
7.exchange.fees: Integrator fees charged by 7.exchange on finalized swaps (the integrator_fee item). Excludes gas, relayer, and other third-party costs.

AKKA.revenue: All the fees from swap events go to the protocol.
AKKA.fees: Fees are tracked from the fee field in Swap events in the output token, excluding charges not reported by router builds that emit zero fees.

ALPHA Launchpad.revenue: The 1% protocol fee taken on every trade.
ALPHA Launchpad.fees: Trading fees paid by traders on bonding curves and on graduated pools: a 1% protocol fee plus a creator fee of 0, 0.25 or 0.5%. On Solana, graduated pool fees are the ALPHA share of the Meteora DAMM v2 pool fee, counted when claimed, and the fee on a creator's first buy inside the launch transaction is not counted because no event reports it.

AUTOfinance.revenue: Performance fees charged on positive performance and management fees if any
AUTOfinance.fees: Includes Yields on all the vaults, performance fees and management fees

Aark Digital.fees: All fees paid by users for executionFee, openFee, closeFee.

Aave Labs.revenue: All swap fees are collected as revenue.
Aave Labs.fees: All swap fees from Aave frontend using CowSwap integration.

Aave V3.revenue: Amount of fees go to Aave treasury.
Aave V3.fees: Include borrow interest, flashloan fee, liquidation fee, penalty paid by borrowers, swap fees from the Aave frontend (Paraswap, then CoW Swap), and Chainlink SVR (MEV recapture from Ethereum liquidations).

Abracadabra Spell.revenue: Protocol's share of Cauldron fees: all interest and borrow/opening fees (MIM is minted, there are no lenders) plus 10% of liquidation penalties.
Abracadabra Spell.fees: Fees paid by MIM borrowers in Abracadabra Cauldrons: interest on outstanding debt, a one-time borrow/opening fee, and liquidation penalties. Tracked from on-chain cauldron events (LogAccrue, LogBorrow, LogRemoveCollateral + LogRepay pairs for liquidations).

Accountable.revenue: The Accountable protocol's share of the performance and management fees.
Accountable.fees: Value earned by Accountable vaults over the day, read on chain: for credit vaults the interest accrued by borrowers, for NAV, looping and fixed-term vaults the increase in share price plus the fee shares minted out of it, and for collateral fixed-term vaults the one-off management fee charged at loan acceptance, spread evenly over the loan term.

Across.fees: Total fees paid by users for bridge txs, counted on the destination chain at the time of the deposit.

Adexto.revenue: The protocol leg of every swap, paid to the ADEXTO protocol treasury: 0.10% of the trade on factory 0.11.0, 0.12.0 and 1.0.0 markets, where it is a factory constant. Factory 0.10.0 markets have no protocol leg.
Adexto.fees: All swap fees paid by traders on ADEXTO bonding curves, read from each Swap event: the creator, curve reserve, buyback and protocol legs. Rates are set per market at launch and never change; the launch presets are 1.00% on factory 1.0.0 and 0.12.0 markets and 0.40% on factory 0.11.0 markets.

Aera V3.revenue: Revenue represents Aera's share of vault performance.
Aera V3.fees: Fees reflect the daily gains or losses generated by vault assets.

Aero Basic.revenue: Swap fees earned by AERO-earning liquidity and bribes, all distributed to sAERO holders.
Aero Basic.fees: Swap fees paid by traders, plus bribes paid to the protocol to attract AERO Rewards to pools.

Aero Slipstream.revenue: Swap fees earned by AERO-earning liquidity, the protocol share of fee-earning liquidity fees and bribes, all distributed to sAERO holders.
Aero Slipstream.fees: Swap fees paid by traders, plus bribes paid to the protocol to attract AERO Rewards to pools.

Aethir.fees: Service fees paid by developers to use aethir GPU services

Ajna V2.revenue: ~10-15% of borrower interest accumulated in pool reserves, held by the protocol pending reserve auctions
Ajna V2.fees: Total interest paid by borrowers: ~85-90% to lenders and ~10-15% to protocol reserves

Alchemix V2.revenue: Protocol fee share from gross yield harvested.
Alchemix V2.fees: Alchemix generates revenue from various lending and yield optimization activities across its protocol.

Alchemix V3.revenue: MYT performance fees and realized Alchemist/Transmuter protocol fees collected by the Alchemix protocol.
Alchemix V3.fees: Gross yield generated by all Alchemix V3 ERC-4626 (MYT) vaults, measured from each vault's share-price (convertToAssets) growth over the measurement period and grossed up by the on-chain performanceFee(), plus realized Alchemist/Transmuter protocol fees transferred to the fee receiver.

AlienFi.revenue: Percentage of swap fees going to treasury and/or token holders

Allbridge Core.fees: Bridge fees (a share of the transferred stablecoin) plus relayer fees (paid in native gas or deducted from the stablecoin) paid by users on the source chain of every Allbridge Core transfer.

Alphix.revenue: Share of 30% yields from deployed lending strategies to Alphix.
Alphix.fees: Total swap fees from Uniswap pools + yields from deployed lending strategies.

Angle.revenue: Portion of fees retained by the protocol and distributed to veANGLE holders, including borrow interest, liquidation fees, protocol swap fees, and veANGLE fee distributions
Angle.fees: All fees collected by the protocol including borrow interest, liquidation fees, swap fees, and fees paid to SLPs and keepers

Aori.fees: Fees is calculated as the difference between the input and output amounts.

ApeSwap AMM.revenue: A 0.05% (bsc and ethereum) or 0.15% (polygon and telos) of the fees goes to treasury, 50% of that fee is used to buyback and burn BANANA, on Telos 25% of the collected fees goes to Telos

Apex Omni.revenue: 50% of fees used to buy back APEX tokens.
Apex Omni.fees: All fees collected from trading on APEX Omni exchange.

Arbitrum Exchange V2.revenue: 80% of swap fees (0.20% of volume), minted as LP tokens to the protocol's fee multisig. It went to ARX stakers until March 6, 2024, and has stayed with the protocol since.
Arbitrum Exchange V2.fees: 0.25% swap fee paid by traders on every trade.

Arbitrum Exchange V3.revenue: Percentage of swap fees going to treasury and/or token holders
Arbitrum Exchange V3.fees: Swap fees paid by users, ranging from 0.008% to 1% depending on the pool.

Arbitrum Timeboost.revenue: All fees go to Arbitrum protocol treasury.
Arbitrum Timeboost.fees: All priority/boost ETH fees paid by users for transactions.

Arkada.revenue: 100% of pyramid claim fees and verification fees are retained by Arkada.
Arkada.fees: All fees paid by users for Arkada pyramid claims and paid verifications.

Arrakis Modular.revenue: Manager fee taken by Arrakis out of the trading fees earned by vault positions.
Arrakis Modular.fees: Gross trading fees earned by Arrakis Modular vault positions, recovered from the manager fee actually taken out of each position and the manager fee share that was in force for that vault at the moment the fee was taken. Vaults on the Uniswap V3 module, which pays the manager without emitting an event, are not included.

AssetClaw.revenue: The AssetClaw fee on RWA Native route transfers, all kept by the AssetClaw treasury.
AssetClaw.fees: RWA Native route only: the AssetClaw fee paid to the treasury, 1% of the amount, 0.5% for Genesis 625 NFT holders. Privacy and Standard route fees are not counted.

Auragi Finance.revenue: Percentage of swap fees going to treasury and/or token holders

AutoRange.revenue: The platform's performance-fee cut of those trading fees, set per-vault by PlatformConfig and capped by the vault owner.
AutoRange.fees: Total Uniswap V3 trading fees earned by all AutoRange vaults' positions, realized on rebalance or when the vault owner manually claims — the full amount before the platform/owner split.

Avalon Finance.revenue: Percentage of interest going to treasury

Axelar.fees: Total gas fees paid by users (excluding gas refunds)

Azuro.revenue: Total pools profits (equals total bets amount minus total won bets amount)
Azuro.fees: Total pools profits (equals total bets amount minus total won bets amount)

BIM Yield.revenue: 9% of each harvest is charged as a performance fee for staking, 0.25% for every swap and 0.125% for every bridge.
BIM Yield.fees: 9% of each harvest is charged as a performance fee for staking, 0.25% for every swap and 0.125% for every bridge.

BackedFi.revenue: All fees are revenue for the protocol
BackedFi.fees: Up to 0.50% of your investment's value is charged when entering and exiting the investment (0 fees as of now)

Balancer V2.revenue: Balancer V2 protocol collects 50% swap fees as revenue.
Balancer V2.fees: All trading fees collected (includes swap and yield fee)

Balancer V3.revenue: Revenue earned by the protocol and holders, which is 25% ( 50 % before 2026-04-23 ) of the trade fees and 10% of the yield capture.
Balancer V3.fees: Fees earned from all the trades and yields.

Barker.revenue: All x402 call fees paid by AI agents are kept by the protocol.
Barker.fees: x402 pay-per-call fees paid by AI agents for Barker's MCP stablecoin-yield tools ($0.001–$0.05 per call), settled onchain in stablecoins to the protocol payment wallet.

Base App.revenue: Fees collected by Coinbase paid by users for trading, swapping, bridging in Coinbase Wallet, in tokens and in the native coin, and referral fees from coins created in the Base App. Excludes what the fee wallet receives in its own swaps. On OP Mainnet, token fees are counted only before 2026-10-07.
Base App.fees: All fees paid by users for trading, swapping, bridging in Coinbase Wallet, in tokens and in the native coin, and referral fees from coins created in the Base App. Excludes what the fee wallet receives in its own swaps. On OP Mainnet, token fees are counted only before 2026-10-07.

Based Aggregator.revenue: All app fees accrue to the Based protocol; there is no supply-side or holder share.
Based Aggregator.fees: 1% (100 bps) app fee charged on swaps routed through Relay, collected in USDC. Reported per origin chain of the swap.

BasisOS.revenue: Sum of management and performance fees collected from all vaults
BasisOS.fees: Sum of management and performance fees collected from all vaults

Beefy.revenue: All fees except for 0.5% to strategist and variable harvest() call fee are revenue
Beefy.fees: 9.5% of each harvest is charged as a performance fee

BetSwirl.revenue: Dividends, Treasury and Team fee allocations.
BetSwirl.fees: All fees (called «house edge» from 2.4% to 4% of the payout) comes from the player's bet. The fee has several allocations: Bank, Partner, Affiliate, Dividends, Treasury, and Team. The house edge on PvP games is from 3.5% to 7% allocated to Dividends, Host, Affiliate, Treasury and Team.

Binance Alpha.revenue: All fees are collected by Binance.
Binance Alpha.fees: Fees paid by users while trading via Binance Alpha app.

BlackRock BUIDL.revenue: Management fees (18-50 bps depending on the blockchain and BUIDL share class)
BlackRock BUIDL.fees: Total yields generated from the fund's underlying assets (U.S. Treasuries and repo agreements) plus the management fees charged by BlackRock

Boardwalk.revenue: Boardwalk's share of the transfer tax (default 35bps of the 95bps tax, 30bps when a referrer is set), split 10% treasury / 90% governance. Revenue from non-Ethereum chains is bridged weekly to Ethereum, where the split applies (net of bridge fees).
Boardwalk.fees: Transfer tax (0.95% default, higher during the anti-whale decay window after launch) charged on every non-exempt transfer of Boardwalk-launched tokens, valued in WETH at the launch pair spot rate. The Uniswap v2 pair fee is not counted.

Boros.revenue: Include open/close fees and settlement fees going to the protocol.
Boros.fees: Includes open/close trades fees, swap fees, liquidation and settlement fees.

Boson Protocol.fees: A fee is charged on every successful trade executed on the Boson Protocol.

Buffer Finance.revenue: Protocol revenue from trading fees retained by Buffer
Buffer Finance.fees: Trading fees collected from options trading on the Buffer protocol

Bungee Bridge Aggregator.revenue: Total fees paid are distributed to Bungee integrations.
Bungee Bridge Aggregator.fees: Total fees paid by users from swap and bridge transactions.

Cakepie.revenue: Staking rewards collected from assets staked on PancakeSwap
Cakepie.fees: Staking rewards collected from assets staked on PancakeSwap

Camelot V2.revenue: Portion of trading fees that goes to the protocol (17.5%) and xGRAIL holders (22.5%), totaling 40% of swap fees.
Camelot V2.fees: Trading fees charged on swaps. Camelot V2 is a Uniswap V2 fork with 0.3% swap fee.

Camelot V3.revenue: The share of trading fees Camelot keeps rather than paying out to liquidity providers, read from each pool on-chain: 15% on Arbitrum, 20% on the other chains, and 0% on pools where Camelot has waived its cut.
Camelot V3.fees: Trading fees paid by swappers. Each pool sets its own fee, which moves with volatility, and is read from the pool itself.

Camelot V4.revenue: The community fee share of swap fees, read per pool on-chain (20% on every initialized pool today), minus Algebra's cut taken by the community vault.
Camelot V4.fees: Swap fees paid by traders, at the fee each swap was charged: the override fee the pool plugin logs with the swap, or the pool fee when no override is set.

Chainlink Requests.fees: Sum of all fees from Chainlink Requests,Chainlink Keepers,Chainlink VRF V1,Chainlink VRF V2,Chainlink CCIP.

Challenge4Trading Perp.revenue: All the fees (open fees, close fees, liquidation fees, and rollover accruals) are revenue.
Challenge4Trading Perp.fees: Daily fees are tracked onchain from Arbitrum events and include open fees, close fees, liquidation fees, and rollover accruals emitted by the perp contract.

Chamber Vaults.revenue: All revenue collected by the dHEDGE protocol from fees generated: the DAO fee (daoFee) collected from all vaults.
Chamber Vaults.fees: All fees generated from dHEDGE vaults: manager fees (performance and management) and deposit/withdraw fees from dHEDGE vaults, excluding Toros and mStable vaults which are tracked in their own adapters, plus the dHEDGE DAO fee collected from all vaults on the platform.

Charm Finance V2.revenue: 2-5% swap fees taken as performance fees
Charm Finance V2.fees: Swap fees generated by providing liquidity to pools of various protocols

CheapGM.revenue: fees accrue to protocol treasury. If no GMCounter address provided for a chain, fallback is treasury net inflow for that chain/day.
CheapGM.fees: fees from GMCounter logs: if referral is set, fee x (1 - referralFees/BPS), otherwise full fee.

Chronos V1.revenue: Percentage of swap fees going to treasury and/or token holders

Circle CCTP.fees: Fast transfer fees(0-14 BPs) and forward fees charged by CCTP

Clearpool Lending.revenue: Protocol share of Dynamic pool borrower interest, plus Prime pool spreadFee and originationFee repayment fees.
Clearpool Lending.fees: Interest and protocol fees generated by Clearpool lending products: Dynamic pools, Prime pool repayment fees, and Port vault NAV yield.

Clearstar.fees: Total yields from deposited assets in all curated vaults.

Clipper.revenue: Percentage of swap fees going to treasury and/or token holders

CoWSwap.revenue: CoW DAO share: protocol fees, ~25% partner service fee, and 50% of MEV Blocker fees/sale proceeds
CoWSwap.fees: Swap fees from the sell token: protocol fees (50% surplus + 2bps volume), partner fees, and MEV Blocker fees

Coinbase Bridge.fees: No fees are charged when minting and redeeming cbBTC.

Compound V3.revenue: Spread between borrow interest paid by borrowers and supply interest distributed to lenders. Accumulates as protocol reserves on each Comet contract, withdrawable to the Compound DAO Treasury via Governance.
Compound V3.fees: Total borrow interest paid by borrowers across Compound V3 markets.

Concrete.revenue: Management and performance fees collected by the protocol as vault shares.
Concrete.fees: Total yield generated by the vaults' strategies for depositors, measured from the growth of each vault's exchange rate on-chain, plus protocol fees and partner staking rewards campaigns.

Contango V2.revenue: Revenue consists of the service fees collected from trades on both correlated and non-correlated pairs.
Contango V2.fees: Trading fees include 0.05% for correlated pairs and 0.25% for non-correlated pairs, plus automation fees for TP/SL orders and flash loan fees.

Curve DEX.revenue: The share of pool fees kept by the protocol rather than paid to liquidity providers - usually half of the fee - plus bribes.
Curve DEX.fees: Swap and liquidity fees charged by Curve pools, plus bribes paid to veCRV voters. Fee rates are set per pool - around 0.01%-0.04% on stable pools and up to a few percent on volatile pools.

Curve LlamaLend.revenue: AMM admin fees collected by Curve DAO.
Curve LlamaLend.fees: Total borrow interest paid by borrowers plus AMM swap fees from LLAMMA liquidation AMMs.

Cybro.revenue: ProtocolFeeCollector keeps the whole cut. Pool fees that stay with the user are not included.
Cybro.fees: Cybro LP and auto managers charge 10 bps when a position is opened, increased, withdrawn or moved, and 10 bps of pool fees that are claimed or compounded. The cut is an ERC-20 transfer into ProtocolFeeCollector.

D2 Finance.revenue: 20% performance fee, 0% management fee on the flagship strategy, and 2% management fee on other strategies.
D2 Finance.fees: All yields are generated from all staking assets across all trading strategies.

D8X.fees: Trading and liquidation fees paid by traders.

DODO AMM.revenue: Maintainer share of swap fees, sent to each pool's maintainer address (DODO's fee receiver on factory pools).
DODO AMM.fees: Swap fees paid by traders on DODO V1 pairs and V2 pools, at each pool's own LP and maintainer fee rates. Excludes the separate route fee charged by the DODO aggregator router.

DackieSwap V2.fees: All fees comes from the user.

DackieSwap V3.revenue: Protocol fees collected by DackieSwap - 0.05% of each trade for most pools
DackieSwap V3.fees: Total trading fees - sum of LP fees and protocol fees. LP fees vary by pool type (0.25% for most pools, with some special pools having different rates). Protocol fees are 0.05% for most pools.

DashsWallet.revenue: Portion of surplus retained by the DashsWallet treasury after deducting cashback.
DashsWallet.fees: Total surplus captured on DashsWallet swaps — difference between actual swap output and the user's minimum accepted amount.

DeBank Cloud.revenue: All on-chain deposits and swap fees collected by DeBank. Card/fiat payments are not included as they are settled off-chain.
DeBank Cloud.fees: USDC/USDT deposits paid by users to top up DeBank Cloud / DeBank credit, plus swap fees collected by DeBank. Note: this does not include payments made by card/fiat, which DeBank also supports but are settled off-chain.

Defi Saver Asset Management.revenue: Total fees paid are distributed to DefiSaver.
Defi Saver Asset Management.fees: Total fees paid by users for using DefiSaver services, excluding tokens sent back to the fee wallet from DefiSaver's own treasury wallets.

Definitive.revenue: Trading fees are split between Definitive and EDGE holders
Definitive.fees: User pays 0.25% - 0.85% fee on each trade. Majors and Stables have feeless trading.

Denaria GMX.revenue: All Denaria fees (GMX UI fees, affiliate rewards, service fees) are revenue.
Denaria GMX.fees: Fees collected by Denaria: the GMX UI fee charged on Denaria orders, the affiliate reward earned by the DENARIA referral code on GMX position fees, and the flat per-operation service fee paid to the Denaria fee wallet. GMX position, borrowing and funding fees are not Denaria fees and are counted under GMX V2 Perps.

DexFi Aggregator.revenue: All collected fees are protocol revenue (no separate liquidity provider supply-side)
DexFi Aggregator.fees: Harvest fees comes to treasury contracts on each chain

DigiFT.revenue: Platform fees paid by users on subscription and redemption, plus the 0.15% annual management fee charged on ULTRA assets under management.
DigiFT.fees: Platform fees on subscription and redemption of tokens, plus ULTRA yield from NAV growth and the 0.15% annual management fee.

Dinari.revenue: Trading fees (flat + variable) charged on buy and sell orders of tokenized stocks (dShares). All fees are revenue.
Dinari.fees: Trading fees (flat + variable) charged on buy and sell orders of tokenized stocks (dShares).

Dolomite.revenue: Portion of fees that goes to the protocol

DropSwap.revenue: Includes part of integrator fees retained by the protocol and part of integrator fees used to fund $DROP buybacks and burns.
DropSwap.fees: A 0.25% integrator fee is charged on the input token of every swap routed through DropSwap, recorded per chain in DropSwap's own database.

Dune Protocol.revenue: Includes all extracted fees (1% admin fee + 10% vault fee).
Dune Protocol.fees: Fees extracted per round: 1% admin fee on the total ETH deployed and 10% vault fee on losers pool after admin. Variable effective rate depending on winner/loser ratio.

E3.revenue: A variable % of the trading fee is collected as Protocol Fees.
E3.fees: Net Trading fees paid is the Sum of fees sent to LP & Protocol Fees

EISEN Finance.fees: Token trading fees paid by users.

ERC Burner.revenue: All fees collected by the protocol are considered revenue
ERC Burner.fees: User pays 2.5% of the total amount of tokens they are burning. Fees are calculated by tracking the fee amount from BurnSuccess events.

El Dorado Exchange.revenue: Revenue is calculated as 30% of the total fee.
El Dorado Exchange.fees: All mint, burn, margin and liquidation and swap fees are collected

Element NFT Marketplace.revenue: Share of trading fees to Element.
Element NFT Marketplace.fees: Fees paid by traders while trading NFTs on Element market.

Equation V1.revenue: Revenue is 50% of all collected fees
Equation V1.fees: Fees from open/close position and placed limit order (0.05%),  with invitation code (0.045%)

Euler V2.fees: Includes interest that is paid by the borrowers, protocol and curators fees, net of bad debt written off against vault lenders.

Fjord V1.revenue: Revenue is 100% fee of each swap which goes to treasury
Fjord V1.fees: Fees collected from user trading fees

Fjord V2.revenue: Revenue is 100% fee of each swap which goes to treasury
Fjord V2.fees: Fees collected from user trading fees

Fluid DEX.revenue: Fluid takes a portion of swap fees.
Fluid DEX.fees: Total swap fees paid by users.

Fluid Lending.revenue: Percentage of interest going to treasury
Fluid Lending.fees: Interest paid by borrowers on Fluid + revenue share from JupLend

Folks Finance xChain.revenue: Protocol share of borrow interest (retention rate per pool).
Folks Finance xChain.fees: Borrow interest paid across all xChain hub pools.

Frax.revenue: Amount of interest collected by Frax Finance.
Frax.fees: Total interest paid to users by borrowing FRAX.

Frax Swap.fees: A 0.3% fee is collected from each swap

Fraxlend.revenue: 10% interest fee is considered as revenue
Fraxlend.fees: Includes Lenders interest, liquidation fee and 10% interest fee

Friend3.revenue: Fees paid by users while trading on social network.
Friend3.fees: Fees paid by users while trading on social network.

Furucombo.fees: Fees paid by users for using Furucombo services.

FutureSwap.revenue: All reported trade fees are treated as protocol revenue due to lack of on-chain fee distribution data.
FutureSwap.fees: Trading fees as reported by the tradeFee field in PositionChanged events. Futureswap is a leveraged derivatives protocol and does not emit explicit fee settlement events.

GMGN.revenue: Trading fees retained by GMGN after referral commissions. Solana referral is measured on-chain; EVM referral is estimated at the measured Solana referral rate (~16% of fees).
GMGN.fees: All trading fees paid by users while using GMGN AI bot (1% per trade), collected in both the native gas token and USDC, tracked via Dune. Solana = native-SOL + USDC inflows to the fee wallets; EVM = native gas-token + USDC inflows to the fee collector; Elysium (not on Dune) = the FeeCollected events of GMGN's router there.

GMX EVM.revenue: 37% of position fees (after referral rebates) and of borrowing, liquidation and swap fees, split between protocol treasury (10%) and GMX token holders (27%); distributed price impact goes to liquidity providers instead
GMX EVM.fees: Fees from opening/closing perpetual positions, borrowing fees, swap fees, liquidation fees, and positive price impact distributed from the impact pool, decoded from EventEmitter logs

GMX V1 EVM.revenue: Revenue is 30% of all collected fees, which goes to GMX stakers
GMX V1 EVM.fees: Fees from open/close position (0.1%), swap (0.2% to 0.8%), mint and burn (based on tokens balance in the pool) and borrow fee ((assets borrowed)/(total assets in pool)*0.01%)

GND Protocol.fees: total protocol revenue collected from univ3 engine and gmusd.

Gains Network.revenue: Share of trading fees to protocol and token holders.

Gambit Trade.revenue: Fees allocated to protocol governance and stakers.
Gambit Trade.fees: All trading fees collected from perpetual trades, including governance, staking, referral, and LP vault fees.

Gamma.revenue: All yields are distributed to Gamma Protocol.
Gamma.fees: All yields are generated from liquidity providers.

Garden.revenue: 77% of swap fees go to the protocol treasury

Gate Swap Spot.revenue: The portion of swap fees retained by Gate Swap.
Gate Swap Spot.fees: Fees paid by users on Gate Swap routes, reported by the Gate Swap API for each hourly UTC window.

Gauntlet.fees: Total yields from deposited assets in all curated vaults.

Gearbox.revenue: Amount of fees go to Gearbox treasury.
Gearbox.fees: Include borrow interest, performance profit & loss and liquidation fee paid by borrowers.

Giza.revenue: All performance fees are collected by the protocol.
Giza.fees: 10% performance fee charged on yields generated by the protocol.

GlueX.revenue: Revenue is calculated as the sum of routingFee for the old contract and the sum of protocolShare for the new contract.
GlueX.fees: Fees paid by users for swaps.

GoPlus Locker V2.revenue: All collected fees are considered as protocol revenue
GoPlus Locker V2.fees: All tokens received by the protocol's fee recipient addresses

Goat Protocol.fees: 10% of the profit generated by the vaults is charged as a performance fee

Haiku.fees: All fees paid by users for swap and bridge tokens via Haiku.

Hash PayLink.revenue: All tracked fees are collected by the Hash PayLink treasury.
Hash PayLink.fees: Hash PayLink charges a 0.2% platform fee on successful payment settlement. Sponsored smart-wallet payments may also route a small USDC gas recovery amount to the treasury in the same settlement.

Hedgey.revenue: Fees paid by users using payment services.
Hedgey.fees: Fees paid by users using payment services.

Hegic.revenue: The same as Fees, the Stake & Cover pool keeps all of its net premiums.
Hegic.fees: Net premiums retained by the Hegic Stake & Cover pool: everything users pay into the Operational Treasury to open options/strategies, minus everything the treasury pays out on settlement.

Hermes V2.revenue: 100% of fees distributed to governance token holders are revenue.
Hermes V2.fees: All token transfers into MultiRewardsDepot contracts originating from pools and bribes

Hop Protocol.fees: Fees paid by users for bridging tokens via Hop.

Horiza.revenue: Percentage of swap fees going to treasury and/or token holders

House of Joshi.revenue: All House swap fees are retained by the protocol; there is no supply-side fee allocation.
House of Joshi.fees: The 1% House fee paid by users on swaps executed through HojswapRouterV2, using the exact feeAmount emitted for each trade.

Human Passport.revenue: All verification fees collected by the Gitcoin protocol
Human Passport.fees: Verification fees (~$2 USD in native ETH per attestation) paid when users call verifyAndAttest on GitcoinVerifier contracts to bring Gitcoin Passport data onchain

HyperDex Aggregator.revenue: All of these fees go to HyperDex.
HyperDex Aggregator.fees: The 0.25% integrator fee HyperDex charges on every swap, bridge and basket order routed through LI.FI: the FeesForwarded leg paid to HyperDex in a transaction whose LI.FI event carries integrator "hyperdex" (Robinhood Chain and Solana: the integrator share of each transfer's fee from LI.FI's analytics API, in USD); HyperDex's leg of its client fee on Fynd swaps, from the TychoRouter FeesTaken event; and HyperDex's fee on RAVN, Velora, Hinkal and CoW swaps, at its fee rate on each completed swap in HyperDex's own swap record (https://hyperdex.app/api/defillama), at the swap's dollar amount when sent.

HyperFX.revenue: The 0.05% protocol fee, retained by the gateway.
HyperFX.fees: 0.05% protocol fee deducted from order inputs at placement.

Hyperithm.fees: Total yields from deposited assets in all curated vaults.

Hyperlane.revenue: Gross IGP payments to Hyperlane-published relayer contracts.
Hyperlane.fees: User-paid Hyperlane interchain gas payments from InterchainGasPaymaster GasPayment events.

Hypernova.revenue: Assessment fees minus trader payouts and referral and affiliate commissions.

IPOR Fusion.revenue: The IPOR DAO share of performance and management fees, as configured in each vault FeeManager.
IPOR Fusion.fees: Gross yield earned by PlasmaVault depositors plus all fees charged by the vaults (performance, management and deposit fees), measured from the fee shares actually minted on-chain.

Idle.revenue: Includes performance fees paid on yields
Idle.fees: Includes Vault yields and performance fees

Impermax V2.revenue: Percentage of interest going to treasury, based on each lending pool's reserve factor.
Impermax V2.fees: Fees is the interest rate paid by borrowers

Index Coop.revenue: Fees retained by the Index Coop protocol, including manager and protocol portions.
Index Coop.fees: Streaming fees and issuance/redemption fees paid by users.

Infinex Spot.revenue: All collected swap fees accrue to Infinex.
Infinex Spot.fees: All tokens routed to Infinex swap fee collectors across supported chains (USD-converted via Allium).

Integral.revenue: Percentage of swap fees going to treasury and/or token holders

IntentX.revenue: All the trading fees are revenue
IntentX.fees: Perp trading fees paid by users

Jeton.fees: Fees paid by users for trading and bridging.

Joe DEX.revenue: Percentage of swap fees going to treasury and/or token holders

Joe V2.revenue: Share of amount of swap fees.
Joe V2.fees: Total swap fees typically range from 0.01% up to 0.8% of the total amount paid by users.

Joe V2.1.revenue: Share of amount of swap fees.
Joe V2.1.fees: Total swap fees typically range from 0.01% up to 0.8% of the total amount paid by users.

Joe V2.2.revenue: Share of amount of swap fees.
Joe V2.2.fees: Total swap fees typically range from 0.01% up to 0.8% of the total amount paid by users.

Jumper Bridge Aggregator.revenue: All platform fees are kept by Jumper.
Jumper Bridge Aggregator.fees: Jumper platform fees (0-5 bps depending on the assets) paid by users on bridges.

Jumper DEX Aggregator.revenue: All platform fees are kept by Jumper.
Jumper DEX Aggregator.fees: Jumper platform fees (0-5 bps depending on the assets) paid by users on swaps.

K3 Capital.revenue: Interest fees retained by vault curators from vault yields.
K3 Capital.fees: Total yields from deposited assets in all curated vaults.

KPK.revenue: Curator's cut: Euler 5% interestFee on KPK's underlying markets + 50% of Gearbox TreasurySplitter inflows. Morpho is excluded (KPK charges a 0% curator fee on Morpho).
KPK.fees: Gross interest/yield from KPK-curated Morpho and Euler vaults, plus realized Gearbox TreasurySplitter inflows.

KTX Perps.revenue: Revenue is 30% of all collected fees, which goes to KTC stakers
KTX Perps.fees: Fees from open/close position (based on token utilization, capped at 0.1%), swap (0.2% to 0.8%), mint and burn (based on tokens balance in the pool) and borrow fee ((assets borrowed)/(total assets in pool)*0.01%)

Kairos Timeboost.revenue: Revenue of fees after remove costs.
Kairos Timeboost.fees: Kairos pay for auction bids upfront, we subtract the cost from the fees to get the revenue.

Kelp.revenue: Protocol fees from rsETH (on-chain protocol fee on staking rewards), agETH management fees (2%), hgETH management fees (1.5%), and hgETH performance fees (20% of positive rate delta).
Kelp.fees: Sum of total staking rewards from rsETH (ETH staking rewards + EIGEN rewards), agETH management fees, and hgETH management/performance fees.

Kerberus.fees: Fees paid by users for using Kerberus services.

Kleros.revenue: Leftover fees sent to the governor when jurors are not fully coherent.
Kleros.fees: Arbitration fees paid by dispute creators (from Escrow, Curate, and other arbitrable contracts).

Kromatika.revenue: Portion of fees forwarded to the protocol fee address.
Kromatika.fees: Sum of KROM service fees emitted by LimitOrderManager when limit orders execute (LimitOrderProcessed events).

KyberSwap Aggregator.revenue: All collected aggregator fees retained by KyberSwap.
KyberSwap Aggregator.fees: Aggregator fees retained by KyberSwap on routed swaps. Pulled from both ERC20 Transfer events into the fee collector and from native gas-token internal transfers on chains where the indexer covers them.

KyberSwap Classic.revenue: Currently 100% of the dao rewards (10% of the collected fees) goes to all voters (KNC stakers)
KyberSwap Classic.fees: Kyberswap Classic collects a dynamic fee that increases with market volatility and decreases with stable market conditions

KyberSwap Elastic.revenue: Currently 100% of the dao rewards (10% of the collected fees) goes to all voters (KNC stakers)
KyberSwap Elastic.fees: Each pool can have different fees set from the following tires: 0.008%, 0.01%, 0.04%, 0.3% and 1%

LI.FI Bridge Aggregator.revenue: Share of fees kept by LI.FI.
LI.FI Bridge Aggregator.fees: All fees paid by users on LI.FI bridges, including integrator fees.

LI.FI DEX Aggregator.revenue: Share of fees kept by LI.FI.
LI.FI DEX Aggregator.fees: All fees paid by users on LI.FI swaps, including integrator fees.

LSP.Finance.revenue: LSP charges a 0.5% fee (in USDT) on market transactions, and takes 10% fee on users staking rewards.
LSP.Finance.fees: LSP charges a 0.5% fee (in USDT) on market transactions, and takes 10% fee on users staking rewards.

Lagoon.revenue: Portion of performance and management fees to Lagoon protocol.
Lagoon.fees: Total yield to suppliers + fees share to Lagoon protocol + fees share to vault curators.

Lava.revenue: Percentage of interest going to treasury

Layer3.revenue: The portion of the fees retained by the protocol
Layer3.fees: Fees paid by users when minting Cube NFTs on Layer3

LayerZero V1.revenue: ZRO protocol fees moved from UltraLightNodeV2 to the LayerZero V1 Treasury contract via WithdrawZRO. Historically the V1 protocol take rate has been ~0, so this value is typically negligible. Tokens flow to the Foundation treasury and are not burnt by the contract.
LayerZero V1.fees: Native and ZRO fees paid by users for cross-chain messages routed through the LayerZero V1 endpoint, summed from WithdrawNative and WithdrawZRO events on UltraLightNodeV2 contracts across supported chains. Withdrawals lag the actual send() events by the worker/treasury withdrawal cadence; totals converge over time.

LayerZero V2.revenue: ZRO buybacks funded by Stargate ecosystem allocation routed to LayerZero Foundation. LayerZero takes a 0% protocol take rate on messaging fees.
LayerZero V2.fees: Native token fees paid by users for cross-chain messaging, summed from ExecutorFeePaid and DVNFeePaid events on SendUln302 (V2 default) and SendUln301 (V1-compat through V2 endpoints) across supported chains.

Lazy Summer Protocol.revenue: 30% of tips flow to the DAO treasury and SUMR stakers.
Lazy Summer Protocol.fees: TipAccrued share amounts emitted by active FleetCommanders, converted to vault assets via convertToAssets and summed per underlying asset token.

Level Perps.revenue: Revenue is 55% of the total fees, which goes to Treasury and LVL/LGO stakers
Level Perps.fees: All mint, burn, margin, liquidation and swap fees are collect

LilSwap Bridge Aggregator.revenue: Bridge fees retained by LilSwap after partner share.
LilSwap Bridge Aggregator.fees: Bridge fees paid by users on completed transfers.

LilSwap DEX Aggregator.revenue: Swap fees retained by LilSwap after partner share.
LilSwap DEX Aggregator.fees: Swap fees paid by users, including LilSwap's explicit fee and surplus share.

Liquid Bolt.revenue: 20% performance fees on the arbitrage revenue
Liquid Bolt.fees: The revenue distributed by the arbitrage robots

Livepeer.revenue: All the fees go to orchestrators and delegators who stake LPT tokens.
Livepeer.fees: Fees paid by broadcasters for using the Livepeer protocol.

LobbyFi.fees: Total fees paid by delegations buyers.

Lunar Finance Aggregator.revenue: Protocol fees retained by Lunar Finance.
Lunar Finance Aggregator.fees: User-paid fees on underlying DEX protocols plus Lunar platform fees where applicable.

Lunar Finance Bridge Aggregator.revenue: Protocol fees retained by Lunar Finance.
Lunar Finance Bridge Aggregator.fees: User-paid bridge fees including underlying provider fees.

MYX Finance.revenue: Share of trading fees for treasury, ecosystem fund, keepers.
MYX Finance.fees: Total trading fees collected from traders

Maestro.revenue: Trading fees kept by Maestro protocol after referral rewards.
Maestro.fees: All trading fees paid by users while using Maestro bot.

Maia DAO.fees: Maia Vault's bribe revenue from gauge voting + Boost Aggregator protocol rewards

Marquee.revenue: Fund Pool Revenue + Fees are collected as revenue
Marquee.fees: Fee collected from Option Buying and Settlement

Matcha.revenue: all fees are collected by matcha
Matcha.fees: Matcha takes a 0.05% - 0.25% fee on certain pairs for matcha auto trades. On Solana, the fees paid into Matcha's Solana fee wallet inside 0x Settler and Jupiter v6 swaps.

Maverick V2.revenue: The protocol's cut of the swap fee, set per pool. Every pool is currently set to 0%, so this is zero.
Maverick V2.fees: Swap fee charged on the amount paid into each pool, at the rate that pool sets for the traded direction.

Mayan DEX Aggregator.revenue: Fees are 10 basis points (0.1%) of the outbound bridge volume through Mayan WH Swap on each chain. Only source chain transactions pay fees.
Mayan DEX Aggregator.fees: Fees are 10 basis points (0.1%) of the outbound bridge volume through Mayan WH Swap on each chain. Only source chain transactions pay fees.

MetaLeX.revenue: 100% of this 0.3% service fee is retained by MetaLeX as revenue.
MetaLeX.fees: Tracks the 0.3% service fee charged by MetaLeX when fundraising escrows are finalized.

MetaMask Wallet.revenue: Fees collected by Metamask paid by users for trading, swapping, bridging in Metamask wallet.
MetaMask Wallet.fees: All fees paid by users for trading, swapping, bridging in Metamask wallet.

MoneyFi V1.revenue: Revenue share from total fees going to treasury
MoneyFi V1.fees: Total fees generated by the MoneyFi protocol

MorpheusAI.fees: Yield captured from deposits: stETH rebasing (Lido) + Aave V3 interest on wETH, USDC, USDT, wBTC.

Morpho Blue.fees: Total borrow interest paid by borrowers + liquidation bonues earned by liquidators.

Musical Chairs.revenue: Commission from total deposits post referral bonuses.

NFTX.revenue: Vault fees that go to the NFTX treasury because the vault had no LPs or inventory stakers to receive them.
NFTX.fees: Vault fees paid in ETH to mint, redeem or swap NFTs, premium fees paid to redeem recently deposited NFTs, and swap fees on the NFTX AMM's vToken/WETH pools. Excludes early-withdrawal penalties, which are paid in vTokens, and the optional creator royalties paid through the NFTX marketplace zap.

Nabla Finance.revenue: The share of each swap fee kept by the protocol, allocated to the Nabla DAO Treasury.
Nabla Finance.fees: Users pay between 0.01% and 0.1% fees on each swap.

Napier.revenue: Protocol/DAO share of PT/YT fees and of the TokiHook swap fee reserve, based on the Curator-Protocol fee split ratio.
Napier.fees: Total fees paid by users: AMM swap fees (Napier Curve pools and TokiHook pools, the whole swap fee including the part reserved for curators and protocol) and PT/YT fees (issuance, redemption, performance). PT/YT fee events fire on yield collection, not daily.

Native Credit Pool.revenue: The slice of borrow interest Native reserves for itself plus any widget fee it collects. Both are zero today: the reserve rate is set to 0 and no widget fees are being charged.
Native Credit Pool.fees: Interest market makers pay to borrow from Native credit pools, plus the widget fee a front-end can add to a swap. Native takes nothing on the swap itself - a market maker earns from the price it quotes, so that is not counted here.

Nerite.revenue: Share of borrow interest to protocol if any
Nerite.fees: Total interest, redemption fees paid by borrowers and liquidation profit

NodeOps.fees: Payment made by the users, sum totalOrderAmount from OrderRecorded events.

Nova Perps.revenue: The share of opening and closing fees Nova keeps (governance fee).
Nova Perps.fees: All fees traders pay, before any share goes back to Conviction Pool depositors or referrers: opening and closing fees, liquidation closing fees included, plus the borrowing fees paid while a position is open. Funding is paid between traders and is not counted.

Nullmask.revenue: 0.5% protocol fee on shielded pool deposits and 0.5% on withdrawals (Ethereum, Base, BNB Chain, Robinhood Chain, Avalanche, Arbitrum, Monad, Solana), deposit check fees on Solana, plus ZEC rewards received by the Nullmask team wallet from MASK token holder distributions (Solana).
Nullmask.fees: 0.5% protocol fee on shielded pool deposits and 0.5% on withdrawals (Ethereum, Base, BNB Chain, Robinhood Chain, Avalanche, Arbitrum, Monad, Solana), deposit check fees on Solana, plus ZEC rewards received by the Nullmask team wallet from MASK token holder distributions (Solana).

ODOS.revenue: Revenue is equal to the fees collected.
ODOS.fees: All fees paid by users for using Odos services.

OKX Swap.revenue: Commissions paid to OKX's own fee accounts, OKX's DEX interface fee and its 20% share of DEX API partner fees, and the positive slippage paid to those accounts.
OKX Swap.fees: Total comission fees from every trade, plus the positive slippage the routers take from swaps.

Olympus DAO.revenue: Sum of all protocol revenue streams - as a reserve currency protocol, all revenue strengthens the treasury backing OHM
Olympus DAO.fees: Total revenue from all protocol sources across chains: sUSDS/sUSDe treasury yield, CD Facility yield, CD Lending interest, POL fees, and Berachain POL operations (iBGT DEX sales, iBERA staking yield, oBERO exercise proceeds, BERA/iBERA sales). Cooler Loan interest is tracked separately in the cooler-loans adapter.

Omni Exchange V2.revenue: Percentage of swap fees going to treasury and/or token holders

OmniHub.fees: Mint and Publish NFT fees are paid by users

Ondo Yield Assets.revenue: Zero. Ondo passes all of this yield to token holders and currently charges no fee (USDY has no fee, OUSG's 0.15% fee is waived until 2027).
Ondo Yield Assets.fees: The daily yield earned by USDY and OUSG holders, calculated as each token's price increase over the day times the amount of tokens in circulation.

OpenEden TBILL.revenue: Management fees of 0.30% per annum accrued daily on assets under management and the transaction fee collected on subscriptions and supported redemptions (base rate 5 basis points, net of any partnership adjustment up or down).
OpenEden TBILL.fees: Management fee of 0.30% per annum accrued daily on assets under management, plus the transaction fee collected on subscriptions and supported redemptions (base rate 5 basis points, net of any partnership adjustment up or down).

Opensea Seaport.revenue: Marketplace fees paid to OpenSea fee collectors.
Opensea Seaport.fees: Marketplace fees, creator royalties and third-party fees paid in the native token or ERC20s on NFT trades filled through Seaport, on listings and on accepted offers.

Ophis.revenue: Fees retained by Ophis. Ophis-operated chains retain the full fee; on CoW-hosted chains this is net of CoW Protocol's 25% partner-fee share. Unichain and OP Mainnet are temporarily excluded while their reporting sources are unavailable.
Ophis.fees: Ophis fees assessed on successfully settled Ophis-attributed fills, including the 1 bp base fee and capped price-improvement capture. Values come from Ophis' settlement-fill ledger, are bucketed by settlement date, and are valued in USD by the reporting indexer. Unichain and OP Mainnet are temporarily excluded while their reporting sources are unavailable.

Ostium.revenue: 100% of dev opening fees, 100% of oracle fees, and 100% of trading spreads from 2026-04-28 onwards.
Ostium.fees: Gross protocol revenue: opening fees, liquidation fees, oracle fees, dev fees, rollover fees, and trading spreads.

Overtime.revenue: Fees minus sportsbook and casino referral fees, all kept by the Overtime treasury, which has been the only sportsbook liquidity provider since 2026-07-21 (OIP-265) and has always funded the casino and Speed Markets bankrolls. Speed Markets referral fees are not tracked and are not deducted.
Overtime.fees: What bettors lost to the house on settled sportsbook, casino and Speed Markets bets (stakes minus payouts, less winnings paid on protocol-funded free bets), negative when bettors win more than they lose; before 2026-07-21, while the sportsbook pools were shared with external liquidity providers, the sportsbook only counts its SafeBox trading fee and the SafeBox share of profitable pool rounds.

PagCrypto.revenue: Revenue represents fees collected by PagFinance from fiat to crypto settlements.
PagCrypto.fees: Transaction fees paid by users for fiat to crypto settlements.

PancakeSwap AMM.revenue: All revenue generated comes from user fees.
PancakeSwap AMM.fees: All fees comes from the user.

PancakeSwap AMM V3.revenue: Pancakeswap collects amount of swap fees for Treasury and buy back CAKE.
PancakeSwap AMM V3.fees: Total trading fees - sum of LP fees and protocol fees. LP fees vary by pool type (0.25% for most pools, with some special pools having different rates). Protocol fees are 0.05% for most pools.

PancakeSwap StableSwap.revenue: Half of the swap fees (the pool admin fee); the other half stays with liquidity providers.
PancakeSwap StableSwap.fees: Total swap fees charged to traders, using each pool's on-chain fee rate.

Peapods Finance.revenue: Revenue is collected in a wide variety of different tokens and converted to blue chip assets to be kept as protocol revenue (40%) and converted to PEAS for holders revenue (60%).
Peapods Finance.fees: Includes interest paid, auto-compounding LP yields, liquidation proceeds, and LVF open/close actions.

Pear Perps.revenue: All fees are retained by Pear, split between the protocol treasury and token holders, so revenue equals fees.
Pear Perps.fees: Trading fees paid by users on Pear's legacy Arbitrum engine. After 2026-05-27, Hyperliquid and Lighter fees are tracked by pear-interface.

Pendle V2.revenue: Sum of 5% fee from all yield + points accrued and 80% trading fees + sPENDLE instant-exit fees + what PT Looper users pay the treasury.
Pendle V2.fees: Total yield from deposited assets + trading fees paid by yield traders + sPENDLE instant-exit fees + what PT Looper users pay the treasury.

Penpie.revenue: Protocol revenue from boosted PENDLE rewards + Bribes from voting incentives
Penpie.fees: Total boosted PENDLE rewards from liquidity farming + Bribes from voting incentives on Pendle Finance

Permute.revenue: The protocol takes 0% cut of assets during bridging
Permute.fees: The total fee incurred during bridging, including all transaction fees on both the source and destination chains.

Pheasant Network.fees: Total fees paid by users for bridge and swap txs.

PinkSale.revenue: All fees are collected by PinkSale protocol.
PinkSale.fees: All fees paid by users by using PinkSale services.

Pleasing Gold.revenue: All the fees collected on PGOLD<>PUSD/USDPM swaps generates yield for PGOLD stakers
Pleasing Gold.fees: Fees collected on PGOLD<>PUSD/USDPM swaps via the Pleasing Golden spot market.

Plume Vaults.revenue: Platform fees collected by Nest Credit protocol.
Plume Vaults.fees: Total yields generated from real-world asset strategies in Nest vaults, including platform fees.

Pocket Universe Extension.revenue: All fess paid by users while use extension.
Pocket Universe Extension.fees: All fess paid by users while use extension.

PoolTogether V5.revenue: Users in POOL vaults get a % of all prize odds (typically range from 4%-12%)
PoolTogether V5.fees: All the yields earned by pooltogether's assets

Portal.fees: Total fees paid by users or Protocols for using Wormhole Relayers, Executions, CCTP and Cross chain message fees.

PostTechSoFi.revenue: Fees paid by users while trading on social network.
PostTechSoFi.fees: Fees paid by users while trading on social network.

Premia V2.fees: Taker fees paid by traders on each trade, up to 3% of the option premium.

Premia V3.fees: Taker fees paid by traders on each trade, up to 3% of the option premium.

Printr.revenue: 75% of trading fees: team (10%), protocol-controlled memecoin reserve (25%), and buyback (40%).
Printr.fees: Printr charges a 1% fee on all bonding curve swaps.

Privacy Pools V1.revenue: Deposit vetting fees retained by the protocol.
Privacy Pools V1.fees: Deposit vetting fees retained by protocol plus relayer fees paid on withdrawals.

Privacy Pools V2.revenue: Deposit vetting fees kept by the protocol plus the protocol's feeBps share (20%) of the Aave yield.
Privacy Pools V2.fees: Deposit vetting fees, relayer fees taken out of relayed withdrawals (plain, yield-share and withdraw-and-swap routes), and the full Aave v3 yield earned on the ppUSDC / ppUSDT / ppETH yield shares.

Pyth Core.revenue: All update fees accrue to the Pyth protocol treasury.
Pyth Core.fees: Fees paid by users to update Pyth price feeds on-chain. Fee amounts per chain are set by Pyth DAO governance via singleUpdateFeeInWei() on each contract.

Pyth Entropy.revenue: Protocol fees collected by Pyth DAO treasury per randomness request.
Pyth Entropy.fees: Total fees paid per Entropy randomness request. Fee = Provider fee (dynamic, covers gas) + Protocol fee (set by Pyth DAO governance).

QiDao.revenue: 50% of collected fees earned by QiDAO, 50% fees to asset suppliers.
QiDao.fees: Total reward and withdraw fees paid by users.

Rabby Wallet.fees: All fees paid by users for swapping, bridging in Rabby wallet.

Radiant V2.revenue: All platform fees are kept by the protocol (split between the operationExpenses treasury and dLP lockers).
Radiant V2.fees: Platform fees collected by Radiant (reserve-factor cut of borrow interest) and routed through MiddleFeeDistribution.

Radpie.revenue: Staking rewards collected from assets staked on Radiant
Radpie.fees: Staking rewards collected from assets staked on Radiant

Railgun.revenue: All deductions paid by users using Railgun privacy smart contracts are collected by Railgun treasury contracts.
Railgun.fees: All deductions paid by users using Railgun privacy smart contracts.

Rain.revenue: Platform fees only. RAIN-denominated platform fees are sent to 0x0 and burned directly; USDT platform fees are used to buy back and burn RAIN.
Rain.fees: All fees paid by users on Rain Protocol Markets pools: platform fees plus creator, referrer and resolver shares. Fees are denominated in each pool's token - RAIN for most pools, USDT for the rest.

Rainbow Wallet.revenue: 0.85% revenue from trading volume, plus the bridge relaying fee charged on each bridge transfer
Rainbow Wallet.fees: 0.85% fees from trading volume, plus the bridge relaying fee charged on each bridge transfer

Ramses CL.revenue: 80% of swap fees, split between the protocol treasury and token holders plus external bribes paid to holders who vote.
Ramses CL.fees: Swap fees paid by users on each trade plus external bribes paid to influence gauge votes.

Ramses CL V2.revenue: Voter and treasury shares of swap fees, allocated when each fee accrues, plus external bribes paid to voters. Swap fees count only swaps the Ramses subgraph priced in USD.
Ramses CL V2.fees: Swap fees paid by traders plus external bribes paid to voters of the pools. Swap fees count only swaps the Ramses subgraph priced in USD; bribes are valued at the subgraph token price on the bribe day.

Ramses Legacy.revenue: Percentage of swap fees going to treasury and/or token holders

Ramses Legacy V2.revenue: Voter and treasury shares of swap fees, allocated when each fee accrues, plus external bribes paid to voters. Swap fees count only swaps the Ramses subgraph priced in USD.
Ramses Legacy V2.fees: Swap fees paid by traders plus external bribes paid to voters of the pools. Swap fees count only swaps the Ramses subgraph priced in USD; bribes are valued at the subgraph token price on the bribe day.

Rango.fees: Platform fees, affiliate fees and destination executor fees charged by Rango on swaps and cross-chain transfers. On Solana, where there is no fee event to split, net inflows to the fee collector are attributed to affiliate fees to match the dominant fee share on EVM.

Re.revenue: Fees recorded in the fee vault
Re.fees: Yield accrued by reUSD and reUSDe, plus fees recorded in the fee vault

Relay.revenue: Platform fees. This is an upper bound: Relay pays qualifying integrators an undisclosed 0-67% revenue share out of it.
Relay.fees: Platform fees, integrator app fees and swap costs paid by users on Relay bridges and swaps, excluding execution costs (network gas).

Reservoir Protocol.revenue: Protocol gross profit is not directly observable on-chain; the wsrUSD rate reflects only yield committed to token holders, not total asset yield.
Reservoir Protocol.fees: Gross yield committed to all wsrUSD holders (total supply × Δexchange rate) plus srUSD holders — settled on-chain yield proxy; off-chain RWA yield settles with a lag.

Revert Lend.revenue: Interest retained by the protocol vault as reserves via the reserve factor.
Revert Lend.fees: Total interest paid by borrowers on their loans plus liquidation bonuses paid by liquidated borrowers.

Revoke.cash.revenue: All batch revoke fees and subscription payments, kept by Revoke.cash.
Revoke.cash.fees: Batch revoke fees ($1.50 per batch, paid in the native token by free users) and Revoke Premium and Ultimate subscription payments in USDC and USDT. Refunds are not deducted.

River Omni-CDP.revenue: River: Borrow and redemption fees to stability pool and satUSD+ holders. NYM: All swap fees to RewardManager for stakers.
River Omni-CDP.fees: Combined fees from River Protocol (borrow, redemption, liquidation) and NYM Protocol (swap in/out fees).

Royco V1.revenue: The amount of incentive/reward goes to Royco Protocol.
Royco V1.fees: Total incentive/reward amount were committed by Incentive Providers.

Rubicon.revenue: Protocol cut: Aquila V2 ~5 bps (1/6 of LP fee) on OP/Arb/Base where factory.feeTo is set, 0 on mainnet; CLMM V3 read live per-pool per-timeslot from pool.slot0().feeProtocol (currently 1/6 on the Arbitrum and Base pools checked, 0 where the fee switch is off), so historical periods before any fee-switch change are attributed correctly; Classic 100% of the 2 bps taker fee.
Rubicon.fees: Total user-paid trading fees across all four systems: Aquila V2 = 30 bps × swap notional, CLMM V3 = per-pool tier (5/30/100 bps) × swap notional, Classic = 2 bps × take-event notional.

RubyScore.revenue: All received native coin is treated as revenue.
RubyScore.fees: All received native coin is treated as revenue.

SMARDEX AMM.revenue: 0.02% of each swap on Ethereum is collected for staking pool (SDEX holders that staked). On other chains, 0.03% of each swap is collected for buybacks and burns. Refer to https://docs.smardex.io/overview/what-is-smardex/fees for detailed information.
SMARDEX AMM.fees:
A minor fee is collected on each swap, functioning as trading fees.
The fees are set at 0.07% on Ethereum and 0.1% on other chains.
On other networks, fees may vary between different pairs and chains.
Refer to https://docs.smardex.io/overview/what-is-smardex/fees for detailed information.

SOCKET Protocol.revenue: Total fees paid are distributed to SOCKET inetrgations.
SOCKET Protocol.fees: Total fees paid by users for bridging tokens.

SOFA.org.fees: Fees are collected, transferred to the mainnet, swapped to RCH, and then burned.

Sablier Legacy.revenue: All of it. The fee is Sablier's only income and none of it is shared with liquidity providers, stream creators, or integrators.
Sablier Legacy.fees: The flat fee users pay when they claim tokens from a Sablier stream or airdrop. It is charged in the chain's native coin and targets a fixed dollar amount (around $1, waived to $0 on most chains since 22 April 2026, though the Sablier app still attaches it by default). Nothing is charged as a percentage of the tokens being streamed. Counted from 3 February 2025, the day Sablier began charging.

Saddle Finance.revenue: Amount of swap fees shared to admin.

Safe.revenue: All fees paid out to Safe are collected by Safe.

Scrooge DEX Aggregator.revenue: Scrooge's fee on each swap: taken by ScroogeRouter on Robinhood Chain, paid as Relay's app fee on swaps through Relay, and paid in SOL to Scrooge's Solana fee wallet on Solana. The fee a partner site adds goes to that site and is not included.
Scrooge DEX Aggregator.fees: Scrooge's fee, taken by ScroogeRouter from each swap's output (the fee field of Swapped and SwappedMany), plus the fee a site embedding Scrooge's swap widget charges on top through ScroogePartner (at most 1%). Shift Protocol.revenue: Performance fees (5-20%) on vault profits and management fees (0-2% annually) on AUM, all accruing to the protocol treasury.
Shift Protocol.fees: All yields generated by Shift Protocol vaults from delta-neutral strategies, basis trading, and LP positions, plus performance fees and management fees.

Silo V2.revenue: The portion of Silo V2 fees kept by the protocol treasury.

Silo V3.revenue: DAO share of borrow interest and flash loan fees.
Silo V3.fees: Interest paid by borrowers and flash loan fees across all Silo V3 lending markets.

Smithii.revenue: All fees are collected by smithii.io protocol.
Smithii.fees: All fees paid by users to use a particular Smithii tool.

Snuggle.revenue: The share of the 15% performance fee that lands in the vault treasury. The part paid out to a position owner's referrer is counted as supply side instead.
Snuggle.fees: Trading fees and staking rewards earned by the concentrated liquidity positions the vaults manage, scaled up from the performance fee the vault moved to its treasury.

SolidLizard Dex.revenue: Percentage of swap fees going to treasury and/or token holders

Solidly V3.revenue: Percentage of swap fees going to treasury and/or token holders

SolvBTC.revenue: Protocol share of staking rewards plus all mint/redemption fees collected by Solv Protocol.
SolvBTC.fees: All yields are generated from staking assets and mint/redemption fees.

Sommelier.revenue: Management fees (~1% annual on TVL) plus performance fees (~10-20% on profits above high-watermark) collected by Sommelier protocol. Estimated at ~5% of total yield. Fees are accrued via keeper system in FeesAndReserves contract.
Sommelier.fees: Total yield generated by Sommelier Cellars from deposited assets, calculated from daily share price growth across all vaults. Represents the total value created before any fees are extracted.

SoneVibe.revenue: 1/6 of swap fees (~0.0417%) accrue to the protocol via the factory feeTo LP mint.

Spectra V2.revenue: Yield trading fees, voting fees, and voting incentives distributed to veSPECTRA holders.

Spiko.revenue: Spiko management fees on assets under management: 0.25%/yr for the T-bill funds (USTBL/EUTBL/UKTBL), 0.10%/yr for the Cash & Carry funds (SPKCC/eurSPKCC), and 0.25%/yr for the Amundi Overnight Swap funds (SAFO/eurSAFO/gbpSAFO/chfSAFO). Spiko.fees: Net NAV growth from Spiko funds (USTBL/EUTBL/UKTBL/SPKCC/eurSPKCC and the SAFO Amundi Overnight Swap funds) distributed to holders, plus Spiko's annual management fee. The published NAV is already net of fees, so the management fee is added on top to reconstruct gross fees.

Stargate V1.revenue: Total bridge fees paid by users
Stargate V1.fees: Total bridge fees paid by users

Stargate V2.revenue: Total bridge fees paid by users
Stargate V2.fees: All fees paid by users while using Stargate bridge.

Steakhouse Financial.fees: Total yields from deposited assets in all curated vaults.

Stealcam.revenue: All steal fees are retained by the protocol

StonkBrokers Safe Launch.fees: Safe Launch / Stonklauncher snipe tax on window buys and sells across all pad generations (16.5% creator / 16.5% protocol / 50% locked-LP or ICO Bonus / 17% StockBooster + Clock In Card referrers); the anti-snipe fair-launch snipe tax (time-decay tax on launch-curve buys, 90% StockBooster / 10% launch dev); and StonkCurvePool 1% trade fees (33/33/33 waterfall).

StonkBrokers Smart LP.revenue: The $STONKBROKER-buyback half of the 10% performance fee.

Stryke CLAMM.fees: Protocol fees charged on top of the premium (a fixed percentage of premiumAmount set in the CLAMM FeeStrategy) and sent to the feeTo address. Premiums to LPs are not included.

Stryke RFQ.revenue: All trading fees recorded on confirmed RFQ fills, before subsequent token-holder allocation. Sumer.money.revenue: Protocol and holders share of interest

SushiSwap.revenue: A share of each trade fee goes to xSUSHI stakers.
SushiSwap.fees: SushiSwap Classic charges a flat 0.3% fee.

SushiSwap Agg.fees: Trading fees paid by users while using Sushi Aggregator Routers.

Swapr V2.revenue: 10% swap fees collected by Swapr protocol.

Swapsicle V1.revenue: Percentage of swap fees going to treasury and/or token holders

Sweep n Flip.revenue: Includes 2.5% marketplace fees going to the protocol.
Sweep n Flip.fees: Includes 2.5% marketplace fees and 2% LP fees.

Symbiosis.revenue: The symbiosis share of partner fees, the octopool fee share sent to the protocol fee receiver, and the whole bridging fee, which is paid to the bridge contract.

Synapse Cross Chain Bridge.revenue: Bridge fees, AMM admin fees, flash loan protocol fees, CCTP protocol fees, FastBridge protocol fees, and MessageBus fees accrued to Synapse contracts.
Synapse Cross Chain Bridge.fees: Bridge, AMM, flash loan, CCTP, RFQ, and messaging fees paid by users and emitted by Synapse contracts.

Synthetix V3.revenue: Fees paid by users and awarded to LPs

T3tris Finance.revenue: Earnings sent to the T3tris treasury. Third-party services are also T3tris revenue but are not observable on-chain.
T3tris Finance.fees: Total yield generated by vault strategies, including depositor yield, curator fees and T3tris treasury profit.

THORSwap.revenue: All swap fees, split between the treasury and THOR stakers and buyback.
THORSwap.fees: Swap fees users pay the protocol on top of the route, counted in the hour the swap was created on the chain it sold from. The protocol started charging swap fees on 2022-04-24, so fees before that date are zero.

TRDEFI.revenue: The entire collected trading fee. TRDEFI retains 100% of it, with no share paid to suppliers or holders.
TRDEFI.fees: 0.05% of the amount traded, collected by TRDEFI on positions created through its venue. The fee is embedded in the maker's signed order and paid to the receiver address when the position trades, so it is counted as the incoming token transfers it actually is. The fee rail has been in force since 2026-09-25; positions created before that carry no fee and are immutable.

TeraSwap.revenue: A flat 0.1% (10 bps) fee taken by the FeeCollector on every swap, read directly from the feeAmount field of each SwapWithFee event (no estimation — the exact on-chain value).
TeraSwap.fees: A flat 0.1% (10 bps) fee taken by the FeeCollector on every swap, read directly from the feeAmount field of each SwapWithFee event (no estimation — the exact on-chain value).

TermMax.revenue: Tracks Transfer events to treasury: protocol fees (FT discounted to underlying), liquidation fees (GT collateral), and performance fees.
TermMax.fees: Tracks Transfer events to treasury: protocol fees (FT discounted to underlying), liquidation fees (GT collateral), and performance fees.

The Graph.revenue: Protocol tax on query fees, burned (legacy staking tax, and since Graph Horizon the 1% protocol payment cut burned by GraphPayments)
The Graph.fees: Total query fees paid by users for accessing subgraph data, including the protocol tax burned by GraphPayments since Graph Horizon

Theo Straddle Vaults.fees: Trading PnL generated by Theo straddle vaults, PnL accrues to depositors.

TopCut Finance.revenue: All ETH flows into the TopCutVault. Equals 5% of all ETH flow into TopCutMarkets.
TopCut Finance.fees: 9% of all ETH flows into active TopCutMarkets, i.e. 1.8 times the protocol revenue.

Tornado Cash.revenue: TORN deducted from relayer stakes on each relayed Ethereum withdrawal, paid out of the relayer fee and distributed to TORN governance stakers. Other chains have no protocol fee.
Tornado Cash.fees: Fees users pay to relayers when withdrawing from Tornado Cash pools through a relayer.

Toros.revenue: All revenue collected by the Toros protocol.
Toros.fees: All fees generated from Toros vaults.

TriggerX.revenue: Total ETH fees deducted from deposits by the protocol are collected by protocol as revenue.
TriggerX.fees: Total ETH fees deducted from deposits by the protocol.

Tristero Darkpool.revenue: The loan spread, kept by the protocol. Tristero takes no share of gas abstraction.
Tristero Darkpool.fees: A 1bp (0.01%) per-day loan spread on the total capital in the Tristero vault - idle and lent out, from the vault's own getTVOL accounting - plus gas abstraction paid to fillers for submitting orders on takers' behalf. Both components are charged to users: the loan spread to borrowers, gas abstraction to takers.

Trust Wallet Wallet.revenue: Fees collected by Trust Wallet, less the share of the Safe 0x92f980a7 that its sweeps send to SwapKit.
Trust Wallet Wallet.fees: All fees paid by users for swapping, bridging in Trust Wallet. Captured from ERC20 Transfer events into the fee collectors (USDC and 1%-scaled USDT), including the USDC NEAR Intents and Chainflip pay out to the Safe 0x92f980a7, from native gas-token internal transfers forwarded by the 0x Settler integrator, and from the CoW Swap partner fee that CoW Protocol pays out to Trust Wallet each week.

UNCX Network V2.revenue: All tracked fees are retained by UNCX.
UNCX Network V2.fees: Native and Token fees received by fee collector accounts from official locker and vesting contracts.

USD AI.revenue: The protocol's 10% admin fee on interest from USDai's reserves, GPU-backed loans and escrowed deposits, plus origination, exit and liquidation fees paid by borrowers.
USD AI.fees: Interest earned on USDai's reserves (T-bill-backed wrapped M and PYUSD), on GPU-backed loans and on escrowed deposits, plus origination, exit, refinance and liquidation fees paid by borrowers. PYUSD, loan and escrow interest is counted as it accrues; when a loan repayment pays less interest than had accrued, the difference is subtracted on that day.

UniDex Perp.revenue: Fees going to the treasury + holders
UniDex Perp.fees: Fees collected from user trading fees

Uniswap Labs.revenue: Trading fees are collected by Uniswap Labs.
Uniswap Labs.fees: All trading fees paid by users while using Uniswap frontend.

Uniswap V2.revenue: From 28 Dec 2025, 17% (0% before) fees on Ethereum, From 8 Mar 2026, 17% (0% before) fees on Optimism, Arbitrum, Base, Zora, XLayer chains shared to buy back and burn UNI. (Tracked combined in Uniswap V3 adapter)
Uniswap V2.fees: User pays 0.3% fees on each swap.

Uniswap V3.fees: Swap fees from paid by users.

Uniswap V4.revenue: Fee switch enabled on 27 Jul 2026 (tracked in uniswap-v3 adapter), a part of fees collected to buy back and burn UNI.
Uniswap V4.fees: Swap fees paid by users, excluding wash trading and swaps settled with no tokens changing hands.

Unitus.revenue: The share of borrow interest each Unitus market sets aside as protocol reserves.
Unitus.fees: Interest paid by borrowers on Unitus lending markets.

UniversalX.revenue: 1% of volume fees collected by universalX
UniversalX.fees: 1% of volume fees collected by universalX

Unlock Protocol.revenue: Unlock DAO keeps the protocol fee (1% of each key purchase/renewal).
Unlock Protocol.fees: Gross network product delta recorded by each Unlock contract across supported chains.

Vailox.revenue: All escrow fees are kept by the protocol.

Valorem.revenue: All revenue generated comes from user fees.
Valorem.fees: All fees come from users of Valorem Protocol.

Veda.revenue: The amount of yields are distributed to Veda Protocol.
Veda.fees: Total yields are generated by staking assets.

Velora.revenue: Share of 80% trading fees to Velora, DAO, and token stakers.
Velora.fees: All trading fees paid by users

Venus Core Pool.revenue: Protocol and holders share of borrow interest, plus liquidation income received by ProtocolShareReserve.
Venus Core Pool.fees: Total interest paid by borrowers and liquidation income received by ProtocolShareReserve.

Vibe Trading.revenue: builder code revenue from Symmio Perps Trades.
Vibe Trading.fees: builder code fees from Symmio Perps Trades.

Volmex.revenue: All tracked V1 mint and redeem fees accrue to the protocol treasury.
Volmex.fees: Volmex V1 mint and redeem fees emitted by the protocol Collateralized and Redeemed events.

WINR Protocol.revenue: Zero. No protocol share is deducted on-chain - a 30 day reconciliation shows 100% of settled net gaming revenue accruing to bankroll liquidity providers through share price appreciation, with no leakage to any other on-chain party. The protocol does capture revenue at the application layer, but it is charged and accounted entirely off-chain and is not derivable from chain data, so it is deliberately not estimated here.
WINR Protocol.fees: Net gaming revenue (NGR) settled to the bankroll, measured as WINR received via ProfitReceived minus WINR paid out via LossCovered. This is an NGR figure standing in for a Fees field that conventionally carries GGR: gross wagered turnover is not observable on-chain because games run off-chain, and creator rewards, affiliate commissions and VIP cashback are already deducted in the off-chain escrow ledger before settlement. NGR is the most complete figure derivable from chain data, and this is a known limitation rather than an omission.

WOOFi Swap.revenue: Percentage of swap fees going to treasury and/or token holders

WeDeFin.revenue: Transaction, deposit & withdrawal fees collected by the protocol.
WeDeFin.fees: Fees for minting/rebalancing/selling the index, paid by users.

Whales Market.fees: All tokens received by the protocol's fee wallets (verified via the pre-market contracts' config/UpdateConfig history on EVM and the program config account on Solana): settlement fees from both sides and cancellation fees.

WisdomTree.fees: Includes yields of Fixed income/Money market funds and management fees of all funds

Wombat Exchange.revenue: Protocol share of swap fees plus bribes revenue distributed to WOM voters.
Wombat Exchange.fees: Swap fees paid by users plus bribes rewards deposited for Wombat gauges.

Wompie.revenue: Staking rewards collected from assets staked on Wombat Exchange
Wompie.fees: Staking rewards collected from assets staked on Wombat Exchange

Xpanse Perps.revenue: builder code revenue from Symmio Perps Trades.
Xpanse Perps.fees: builder code fees from Symmio Perps Trades.

Y2K V1.revenue: 5% of Hedge Vault deposits, 5% of Risk Vault deposits upon a depeg event and withdraw fees
Y2K V1.fees: 5% of Hedge Vault deposits, 5% of Risk Vault deposits upon a depeg event and withdraw fees

Yearn Curating.fees: Total yields from deposited assets in all curated vaults.

Yearn Finance.revenue: Performance and management fees to Yearn treasury
Yearn Finance.fees: Total yields from deposited assets across all vaults

YieldFi.revenue: Total management fees and performance fees charged by YieldFi.
YieldFi.fees: Total yield generated by YieldFi across all supported chains + management fees, performance fees by YieldFi

Yieldzio.revenue: 100% of fees (0.1% swap fees on AVLT volume, 0.02% on other volume) received by the fee wallet are protocol revenue.

Zapfi.revenue: All fees are collected as revenue
Zapfi.fees: All fees that are paid by users by depositing in privacy pools

Zarban.revenue: Stability fees and liquidation penalties from CDPs plus the reserve-factor share of liquidity market fees.
Zarban.fees: Stability fees and liquidation penalties paid in ZAR by CDP borrowers, plus borrow interest, flashloan and liquidation fees paid in the Zarban liquidity market.

ZyberSwap Stableswap.revenue: The admin share of swap fees retained by the protocol.
ZyberSwap Stableswap.fees: Swap fees paid by users based on each pool's configured swap fee.

Zyberswap AMM.fees: A 0.25% of each swap is collected as trading fees

Zyberswap V3.revenue: Protocol receives 10% of the dynamic swap fee
Zyberswap V3.fees: A dynamic swap fee is collected as trading fee

cipher.rip.revenue: Fees paid by users while trading on social network.
cipher.rip.fees: Fees paid by users while trading on social network.

deBridge.revenue: Fees are distributed to deBridge protocol.
deBridge.fees: All fees paid by users for swap and bridge tokens via deBridge.

fly.trade.revenue: Swap fees routed to fly.trade's own fee collector, plus the retained positive slippage (surplus).
fly.trade.fees: Swap fees charged by fly.trade's DexAggregator (a conditional 0.01%-0.1% fee on long-tail assets and specific pairs) plus positive slippage (surplus) retained by the router, taken from each Swap event. Pre-2026-05-03 (router migration) fees are taken from the legacy fee collector.

iZiSwap.revenue: Share of swap fees each pool charges for the protocol, set per pool.
iZiSwap.fees: Swap fees paid by traders, the pool fee tier applied to each swap.

vfat Swap.revenue: All router fees go to the vfat.io fee collector.
vfat Swap.fees: The router fee (1 basis point of the output amount) paid by users on every swap.

vfat.io.revenue: All servuce fees collected by vfat.io.
vfat.io.fees: All fees paid by users using vfat.io services.

zERC20.revenue: All v2 withdrawal and note-merge fees and all v1 redeem and unwrap fees paid by users are kept by the protocol.
zERC20.fees: Fees users pay to move tokens privately: since 2026-10-20 a v2 withdrawal fee (0.35% below $10k, tapering to 0.08% above $10M) and a small fee for merging notes, plus on v1 a 0.35% redeem fee on private transfers (since 2026-06-02) and an unwrap fee for converting zTokens back to the underlying token that rises as liquidity runs low; relayer and third-party referral fees are excluded.
